meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 把一次定义好的多步骤任务流程（DAG）存成带名字的文件，之后按名字重新运行，不必每次重复定义。运行时会自动给这个名字加时间戳后缀，使新运行不会复用旧结果；也可指定后缀来复用结果。
howto.when: 当用户想保存一份多步骤任务流程（DAG）、运行一个已保存的此类流程，或反复使用同一个多智能体流程时触发。

say.text: 把这个流程存成 DAG，名字叫 daily-audit。
say.note: 将定义写入库目录，并运行一次进行确认。
按默认规则加时间戳，开启全新运行。

say.text: 给我看看 daily-audit 的定义。
say.note: 只加载定义，不启动运行。

howto.what_en: Stores a multi-step graph (DAG) as a named file and re-runs it by that name. By default it appends a timestamp to the name so each run is fresh; a custom suffix reuses existing run results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or repeatedly use the same multi-agent workflow.

say_en.text: Save this process as a DAG named daily-audit.
say_en.note: Writes the definition and starts it once to confirm.

say_en.text: Run the daily-audit flow I saved earlier.
say_en.note: Adds a timestamp and starts a fresh run.

say_en.text: Show me the definition of daily-audit.
say_en.note: Loads it without starting a run.
